title: The builder Options `isolation?` field defaults to 'host', so a future containe…
description:
The builder Options `isolation?` field defaults to 'host', so a future container call site that forgets to thread `workerIsolation` would silently strip the OAuth token and break the container worker. workerEnvPrefix's required arg guards the internal boundary but not the builder callers. All four current production call sites pass it correctly; consider a comment or a container-side regression test guarding against the omission to harden the latent risk.
